name: OceanLuxx Cruises
summary: OceanLuxx Cruises is a small boat charter business based in Bridgetown, Barbados. It runs a daytime cruise with a buffet lunch and an evening sunset cruise with hors d'oeuvres, both with an open bar. Private charters are arranged by email.
standouts: Online booking with real-time availability and instant confirmation
Full refund for bookings cancelled 72 hours in advance
Cruises rescheduled or refunded when weather stops sailing
Local rates available on request by email

trips.title: Half-day cruise
trips.summary: A daytime cruise along the Barbados coast with a full buffet lunch on board. A premium bar with rum punch, beers and soft drinks is included.
highlights: Premium bar, rum punch, beers and soft drinks included
includes: Premium bar, rum punch, beers and soft drinks
trips.checkNotes: The site's own pages never list trips by name. The About page offers a half-day, sunset or private charter and the FAQ describes a day time cruise with a buffet lunch; the title is taken from that wording. Trip names, prices, times and departure point are only inside the Rezdy widget on /cruises/, which was not opened.

trips.title: Sunset cruise
trips.summary: An evening cruise timed for sunset off Barbados. A selection of hors d'oeuvres is served with a premium bar, rum punch, beers and soft drinks.
highlights: Premium bar, rum punch, beers and soft drinks included
includes: Premium bar, rum punch, beers and soft drinks
trips.checkNotes: Title taken from the About and FAQ wording (evening sunset cruises). Prices, times and departure point are only inside the Rezdy widget on /cruises/, which was not opened.

trips.title: Private charter
trips.summary: The boat can be chartered privately for groups. Packages are arranged by email.
highlights: Packages sent on request by email
trips.checkNotes: FAQ says: For Private Charters, kindly send us an email for packages. Enquiry only; no price shown.

checkNotes: All trips are sold through a Rezdy catalog iframe (oceanluxxcruises.rezdy.com/catalog/534704/cruises) on the home and /cruises/ pages; Rezdy was not opened, so trip names, prices, durations and times are unknown. The /packages/ and /rezdy-items/ pages are empty. The home page also mentions a party on the waves and a leisurely brunch with friends, which may be separate Rezdy products. Address is the map pin on the contact page (Independence Square, Bridgetown); no departure point is written on the site. Footer shows Copyright 2026 and the photos were uploaded in 2023 and 2024. The site does not say whether the boat is a catamaran or a powerboat.
